longDescription: Connect Deep Pan & Griddle Granite Edition The Connect Deep Pan & Griddle Granite Edition features detachable cool-touch handles and a detachable hinge system that transforms one pan into two - a deep sided saucepan and a separate griddle pan. The griddle pan acts as the lid on the deeper pan, and can be detached to become a separate pan, allowing you to cook two lots of food at once. The griddle pan is also interchangeable with the RidgeMonkey Connect Sandwich Toaster Granite Edition. Our all-new granite-style coating makes our pans tougher, more durable, and offers improved non-stick properties taking compact cookware to a whole new level. Available in standard and XL sizes. Granite-style coating with improved non-stick properties 1x griddle pan 1x deep sided saucepan 1x set of removable magnetic, thermoset plastic cool-touch handles with protective pouch Detachable hinge system Lightweight aluminium construction Sleek Gunmetal Grey finish Ridged exterior for even heat transfer Fully compatible with RidgeMonkey Connect Sandwich Toaster Granite Edition Protected registered design Can be used on all traditional stoves and direct heat sources (not suitable for use on induction hobs)

longDescription: Connect Combi & Steamer XXL Granite Edition Why use several different pans when you can use just one? Featuring a deep-sided flat-bottom frying pan, a four-section pan, and a removable steamer tray, the RidgeMonkey Connect Combi & Steamer XXL Granite Edition will help you to create a different offering every day. Featuring a unique detachable hinge system that transforms one pan into two, cool-touch detachable handles for easy storage, and a non-stick coating that is second to none. Our all-new granite-style coating makes our pans tougher, more durable, and offers improved non-stick properties taking compact cookware to a whole new level.
